title: Velocity.ai: rehost cost comparison and price-match proposal
text:
Velocity.ai: rehost cost comparison and price-match proposal

['From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Mike Dalton <mike.dalton@velocity.ai>\\nCc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700\\nSubject: Redwood proposal — price-match option + migration tradeoffs\\n\\nHi Mike —\\n\\nThanks again for the time last week. As discussed, youre evaluating a replacement and want to understand whether we can match their headline economics while also limiting migration risk. I put together a short comparison (attached) that shows two paths:\\n\\n1) Price-match offer: match the incumbent effective unit rate for 12 months with staged credits for onboarding; Redwood remains on the hosted plane for the pilot and then transitions to a dedicated pool if you commit.\\n2) Rehost/replatform: one-time migration credit + implementation SOW; lower long-run unit cost but requires 8–12 weeks of integration and a runway for data migration.\\n\\nKey asks for us to tighten the proposal:\\n- Confirm target headline effective rate (USD/token) youre comparing against (I used the number from your RFP callout).\\n- Any must-have integrations (VPC peering, KMS) for go/no-go?\\n- Who on your side will own procurement/legal and the timeline for execution?\\n\\nIve attached a short risk matrix and a draft pilot SOW we can run concurrently with contract negotiation to speed up go-live. If it helps, Lauren can run a brief TCO snapshot showing token-run assumptions vs your telemetry.\\n\\nWould you be available for a 30-min call Wednesday (5/13) afternoon to walk through the spreadsheet?\\n\\nThanks —\\nAva Chen\\nEnterprise Sales\\nRedwood Inference\\nAttachment: redwood_velocity_price-match-proposal.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)\\nAttachment: rehost-risk-matrix.pdf (PDF, 340KB)', 'From: Mike Dalton <mike.dalton@velocity.ai>\\nTo: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Emma Ruiz <emma@velocity.ai>, Sourcing Team <procure@velocity.ai>\\nDate: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Redwood proposal — price-match option + migration tradeoffs\\n\\nAva —\\n\\nAppreciate the clear framing. A few quick notes:\\n\\n• Headline rate: the incumbent is at $0.0009 / token effective after committed-volume credits.\\n• Integrations: VPC peering is required, KMS optional but preferred.\\n• Timeline: procurement will need ~3 weeks to process an initial PO; legal prefers contract language that includes rollback protections and an agreed-upon staged go-live.\\n\\nWed like to see: a) a price-match sheet that nets to $0.0009 effective for the pilot term, and b) a migration-risk summary with concrete rollback triggers. Please also include your SOC 2 and data residency evidence in the packet so Procurement can start an initial review.\\n\\nIm available Wed 5/13 3–4pm PT for the call.\\n\\n-Mike\\nMike Dalton\\nHead of Platform Engineering \\nVelocity.ai\\nAttachment: incumbent_pricing_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 45KB)', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:28:00 -0700\\nSubject: RE: Redwood proposal — price-match option + migration tradeoffs\\n\\nAva/Team —\\n\\nNice thread. A few internal notes ahead of tomorrow\'s call:\\n\\n- Price-match mechanics: recommend we offer a 12-month \\"effective rate\\" guarantee that combines a reduced per-token rate + an onboarding credit bucket. That keeps our list price intact and caps short-term revenue impact. See the attached workbook for scenarios.\\n- Migration risk: provide an explicit rollback SLA tied to KV-cache parity and a staged traffic split (10/30/60) over 4 weeks. Add a clause for temporary fallback to a compatible model-family in region if performance regression > 10% on latency P50.\\n- Commercial concession: propose a one-time implementation credit up to $45k for migration, tied to milestone delivery and a demo/QA signoff.\\n- Compliance evidence: procurement will ask for SOC2 type II and a short audit summary. I can pull the cert pack (Connor to attach).\\n\\nLauren — can you prepare a one-pager TCO showing run-rate at both the incumbent token rate and the rehosted long-run rate? Put in sensitivity on 20%/40% higher usage.\\n\\nAva — call scheduled for 2026-05-13 15:00 PT (invite sent). Ill be on for the call and can walk the risk matrix.\\n\\nThanks,\\nKarthik\\nPrincipal Solutions Architect\\nAttachment: pilot-sow-draft.docx (Word, 65KB)', 'From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Mike Dalton <mike.dalton@velocity.ai>\\nCc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Sourcing Team <procure@velocity.ai>\\nDate: Fri, 14 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Redwood proposal — price-match option + migration tradeoffs\\n\\nHi Mike / team —\\n\\nThanks for the call earlier — appreciate the candid tradeoff conversation. Inline notes and next steps below:\\n\\n- Pricing: well drop the per-token pilot effective rate to $0.00088 (net of a $60k onboarding credit amortized over the 12-month pilot) so the math nets slightly below your incumbent while preserving a path to our standard list pricing after the pilot. Spreadsheet attached.\\n- Migration guardrails: we agreed to staged traffic split with rollback triggers at 10% model-quality regression or 15% latency increase P50 vs baseline. Well add the fallback model-family clause to the MSA.\\n- Procurement packet: Connor attached SOC2 type II summary, data-residency attestations, and a short implementation timeline.\\n\\nNext steps:\\n1) We will send a redline-friendly term sheet by EOD Monday with the price-match mechanics and rollback language.\\n2) Youll loop in Procurement for the PO process; well provide the final packet for their review.\\n3) Lauren will share the TCO snapshot separately so you can evaluate run-rate scenarios.\\n\\nIf anything else comes up in Procurement, ping me directly — happy to expedite.\\n\\nAppreciate the partnership — look forward to progressing this.\\n\\nBest,\\nAva Chen\\nEnterprise Sales | Redwood Inference\\nDirect: (415) 555-0138\\nAttachment: redwood_velocity_price-match-proposal.xlsx (updated)\\nAttachment: rehost-risk-matrix.pdf (updated)\\nAttachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)']
